Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her lands them both in trouble.

Min Kook asks Woo Jin questions about the primary surgery that Dr. Kim operated on, and Woo Jin hesitates to answer them. The director of Doldam Hospital comes back to the hospital, and Ah Reum greets him. Eun Jae gets furious at Woo Jin for taking away her opportunity to be in the second operation with Min Kook. And Doldam Hospital is on the verge of being sued for malpractice.

Friday is the busiest day as a lot of patients swarm in Doldam Hospital. Eun Jae still finds it hard to perform surgical operations herself. A girl patient who suffers from drug poisoning because of her father's joint family suicidal attempt reminds Woo Jin of a painful memory from his childhood. And the staff of Doldam Hospital resents after hearing a rumor that there will be a new director.

A detective with a gunshot wound and a gang boss with a stab wound come into the ER at the same time. Both of them want Dr. Kim to do the operation, but that's just impossible. Meanwhile, Nurse Oh finds a note at the director's office and notices something is going on with the director. Eun Jae finds a beaten wife in the bathroom and confronts her husband, but something unexpected happens.

Nurse Oh finds out that Director Yeo has lung cancer. A loan shark comes to the hospital and makes a scene to embarrass Woo Jin. Eun Jae feels uncomfortable for causing trouble, so she decides to apologize. Doldam hospital gets a call, and Dr. Kim and Min Guk fiercely conflict over a patient from prison.

Eun Jae loses her confidence from the domestic violence incident, and Dr. Kim cheers her up by telling her that it isn't her fault. A paramedic comes into the ER, unconscious, and she is declared as brain-dead in the end. And the condition of a patient from prison gets worse. Eun Jae finds out that Woo Jin had lost his parents when he was young.

Ho Jun senses something is going on between Woo Jin and Eun Jae. Woo Jin notices Dr. Kim has a problem with his arm. Min Guk gathers doctors and announces to change the system of Doldam Hospital. But Myung Shim gets furious and stands against him. Dr. Kim takes a bus to get back to the hospital, but the bus rolls over.
Mr. Kim receives the key from Geumshim that Mr. Lee left. Meanwhile, Yooseon demands that the company need to implement Internal Monitoring System, and the person in charge is Mr. Kim.

As Mr. Kim gains power to monitor all auditing process, he tries everything he can to find faults and defects about the on-going audit. Those who wish to stop Mr. Kim also tries everything they can to stop Mr. Kim and sets a big trap for him and Gaeun.
The chairman receives an order from above to get a scapegoat to take all the blame. He chooses Yul to take the fall. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim tries to warn Yul that he is a scapegoat.

Mr. Kim sets Yul free from the captive and Yul turns himself in. But in order to bring down Chairman Park, Mr. Kim must free Yul from custody and work with him together. He also needs a plan to protect Yul from Chairman Park and he has an idea.
Seongryong and Yul gather all the documents and evidence to put an end to Chairman Park. With the evidence, they get the arrest warrant approved. Now, this is the start of the end of Chairman Park.

Chairman Park tries to leave the country, but Seongryong and Yul are just right on time to stop him. Although they succeed in catching Chairman Park, they still don't have enough evidence to end everything for good. Plus, running low of funds, TQ group is on the verge of going bankrupt. Seongryong must solve this for the finale.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

Chief Inspector Dreyfus (Herbert Lom) is finally driven mad by Inspector Clouseau's (Peter Sellers) incompetence and commandeers a doomsday device along with a demand for Clouseau’s death. Are 26 hired assassins a match for Clouseau's dumb luck?

Peter Sellers’ comedic genius shines when the hapless Inspector Clouseau is presumed to be dead. However, the very much alive Inspector travels to Hong Kong to investigate a dangerous drug lord (Robert Webber). Dyan Cannon and Herbert Lom also star.
Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.
A classic cult film that features one of the screen's most unlikely pairs. It will defy everything you've ever seen or known about screen lovers.

programmes.d: The legendary live show from the Monty Python troupe. Performing many of their greatest sketches from Monty Python's Flying Circus and two Monty Python specials, Monty Python's Fliegender Zirkus, live from the Hollywood Bowl in 1980.

programmes.t: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programmes.d: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.
A classic cult film that features one of the screen's most unlikely pairs. It will defy everything you've ever seen or known about screen lovers.

For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.
Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programmes.d: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programmes.d: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programmes.d: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programmes.t: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programmes.d: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programmes.st: Harold And Patty Arm Wrestle/Arnold And The Rich Guy
programmes.d: Harold becomes the King Of Arm Wrestling at PS 118. At a hockey game with Grandpa, Arnold prevents an airborne puck from hitting a stranger in the head.

The Racing Mule/Curly's Girl: Mr. Hyuhn, Ernie and Oskar combine their resources to purchase a racing horse. When Rhonda's dad buys her mother a fur coat for her birthday, the temptation is too great and Rhonda wears it to school.

On The Lam/Family Man: Harold, Stinky, and Sid steal rockets out of the science lab at school and set them off outside an old police station. The deli shop where Mr. Hyunh works has a new owner, and he's looking for a new head chef.
Grandpa enters his packard in the classic car competition. It is admired by all until someone admires it enough to steal it. Phoebe is set to receive an award for her perfect attendance.

programmes.st: A Day in the Life of a Classroom/Big Bob’s Crisis
programmes.d: Mr. Simmons wins The Teacher of the Year award and The Knowledge Channel wants to do a documentary capturing the spontaneous moments in his class. Big Bob has a change of heart when he has what appears to be a heart attack.
Married: Rhonda uses her origami marriage predictor to tell who will marry who within the gang. Everyone becomes curious except Arnold.

Timberly Loves Arnold/Eugene, Eugene: When Gerald tries to get rid of his little sister Timberly, Arnold sticks up for her by. Mr. Leichliter, the theater critic, posts auditions for his rendition of the classic play, "Eugene, Eugene".
Arnold and Gerald are cast as a banana and a strawberry in their school play which is written and directed by Helga./Arnold wrecks Eugene's brand new bike.
Helga drops her journal full of love poems about Arnold into a pile of books./ Arnold's class goes on a field trip to the aquarium where Arnold waits to see Lockjaw.

Helga has been secretly building a shrine in her closet to Arnold.  She has been collecting his combs, old school photos, used band-aids and chewing gum, but only one thing will make the shrine complete: Arnold's hat.

Helga tries to hide her disappointment at not being invited to Rhonda's makeover party.  She gives herself her own makeover and crashes the party with the neighborhood boys in tow, trying to out girlie-girl everyone else at the party.

programmes.st: Curse of the Krumm/Krumm Goes to Hollywood
programmes.d: Odiferous Krumm, who put the stink in distinct, loses his stench and fears his monstering days are over.  A Hollywood director mistakes Krumm for an extra on his movie set, and turns him into a star.

programmes.st: Monster Makeover/Airplane, a Wing and a Scare
programmes.d: Wanting a face only a monster could love, Ickis contemplates plastic surgery.  Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina get folded and spindled when they get themselves trapped in a suitcase and are loaded onto a plane bound for Wisconsin.

Krumm sprouts a gigantic pimple.  The pimple has its own personality and is a hit with the other monsters, putting the squeeze on Krumm's popularity.  Monster Hunter Simon says there are real monsters in the world.  But no one believes him.
TV's loveable Murray the Monster is undermining good ghouls everywhere, because kids aren't afraid of him.  Tis the season to be scary, and Oblina, Ickis, and Krumm are happy to oblige.

programmes.st: Chocolate Up To Experience / Three Dag Night
programmes.d: Norbert wants to complete his celebrity curling iron collection by winning the prized Bo Donaldson curling iron. / Dag buys an Easy-Clone oven at a garage sale, much to Norb's amusement.

programmes.st: All In The Colony / Line Duncing
programmes.d: Dag purchases a white ant farm and unwittingly releases a colony of termites who slowly devour the dam. As the boys battle the persistent insect invader, / The Beaver Boys fight over who gets the first bite a rare, ancient oak tree.
Norb and Dag try to battle off a dimwitted warrior. / Norb attempts to save Dag from a band of pirate rats.

programmes.st: Fat Chance / Dag in the Mirror
programmes.d: The Beavers' annual winter bulk-up gets derailed when Dag's hyper metabolism won't let him put on weight. / All is vanity when Dag takes Norb's words to heart that unless you love yourself others can't love you.

Tommy Pickles and his pint-sized pals discover magic, danger and great comic adventure in a world we often take for granted.  Tommy is joined by the twins Phil and Lil DeVille, his best friend Chuckie and Angelica, his three yea
Dummi Bear Dinner Disaster/Twins' Pique: Randy Carmichael's boss, the producer of the Dummi Bears Show, comes over for dinner.
Chuckie's First Haircut/Cool Hand Angelica: The rugrats and Chaz all try to help Chuckie overcome his fear of getting his haircut.
The Tricycle Thief/Rhinoceritis: When Susie's new trike is missing and Angelica shows up on an identical three-wheeler, Susie accuses her of stealing it.

programmes.st: Grandpa Moves Out/Legend of the Satchmo
programmes.d: Grandpa Moves Out/Legend of the Satchmo: Grandpa, starting to feel like he's in the way, moves into a retirement home that looked great on TV but turns out to be boring.
Circus Angelicus/The Stork: After a trip to the circus, Angelica stages her own big top, using the rugrats as her three-ring acts.
The Baby Vanishes/Farewell, My Friend: Angelica puts "vanishing cream" on  Tommy and Chuckie and pretends she can't see them in order to get them to sneak desserts for her.

programmes.st: When Wishes Come True/Angelica Breaks a Leg
programmes.d: When Wishes Come True/Angelica Breaks a Leg: After Angelica is particularly nasty, Tommy wishes something bad would happen to her.
The Last Babysitter/Sour Pickles: When Susie's teenage sister Alisa baby-sits Susie and Tommy for the first time, Tommy and Susie suspect there are monsters loose in the house.
Doug Bags a Neematoad: Doug, the new kid in Bluffington, is tricked into believing that he must catch a strange beast called a Neematoad as part of his initiation to the town.

Doug Takes A Hike/Doug Rocks: When Doug goes camping with the Bluffscouts, Roger chooses him as his partner and makes him do all the work. Doug and Skeeter win tickets to see their favorite rock group, the Beets, but Skeeter is grounded.
Ickis, Oblina, and Krumm are bored when Gromble's old teacher lectures at the academy.  Every boy and monster's worst fear is realized for the Gromble--his mom shows up at he academy unannounced.

programmes.st: Don't Just Do It/Joined at the Hip
programmes.d: Ickis gets a bad case of hero worship when he is befriended by an impulsive monster drop-out Puhg.  When the Gromble gets fed up with Ickis and Krumm, he merges then into a new monster called Krickis.  They're two, two, two monsters in one.

programmes.st: Yak In The Sak Gets Thwacked / Canucks Amuck
programmes.d: A Dr. Seuss type creature appears in the dam to show the boys how to play nice, safe and fair. / When two Canadian beavers claim the Beavers' pond for Canada, the boys are forced into a goofy competition to reclaim what's rightfully theirs, eh.

Combining elements of various outdoor games, the boys pitch and chip their way through their Beaver-rigged indoor golf course. / The boys learn a lesson in hospitality and manners when they visit Big Rabbit's house and meet his rough and tumble family.
Chuckie is dreading Christmas so to liven things up, he steals a tree. Meanwhile, Kira and Kimi are stuck at the airport, and Tommy and Dil try to write a Chanukah song.

Susie is irritated that Angelica doesn't think much about the future. While Angelica is worrying about getting a navel piercing, Susie tries to get a college scholarship. When they're left behind on a school trip, who will get them back home safely?
When Grandpa Lou's buddy Red challenges the kids to work his dude ranch, Tommy jumps at the chance to prove himself, and drags the rest of the Rats along with him.

As Phil and Lil's birthday nears, the twins realize that they are more different than they think. They decide to have separate parties. Meanwhile, Dil is worried that he might turn into a vampire after being bitten by a vampire bat.

Susie coaches Harold to help him get a date with Angelica. He soon becomes the most popular boy in school. Meanwhile, Dil tries to play Cupid himself as he helps Vice-Principal Pangborn woo Miss O'Keats.
Angelica falls for Darryl and gets stuck on a sailboat with her mom the day of his rock concert. Meanwhile, Tommy invites Rachel to dinner but he's afraid she might not like his family.

Tommy goes to Hebrew school to prepare for his bar mitzvah, where he meets Rachel. Tommy is instantly smitten. He goes a little overboard to impress her. Will she forgive him when she finds out that he lied to her?

Tommy is annoyed by Dil's eccentric behavior and needs some space. When the gang visits the Cirque Extravaganza Day Camp, Dil meets a whole group of kids just like him. They invite him to join their troupe. Will he choose them over Tommy?
BTR refuses to record their second album after Gustavo is too hard on them, and the strike pits the determined band against their stubborn producer in a battle of wills.
While Gustavo struggles to write the band's next hit song, the guys try to cheer up Kendall, who is heartbroken after his break-up with Jo.
Hawk has returned and has a new evil plan to take down Big Time Rush. He plans on stealing BTR's new tracks for their second album and releasing them himself.

Secrets are being kept at the Palm Woods. Kendall and Camille are spending a lot of time together making Logan suspicious. James reveals he never told Carlos that Heather Fox, Carlos' camp crush, liked him.

The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

Helen enlists the aide of Drake and Josh after laser eye surgery leaves her temporarily blinded.  When they lose Helen after taking advantage of her many at-home amenities, they are forced to ask themselves, who's the blind one in this situation?
After a botched weightlifting routine, Josh injures his toe and is forced to the hospital. Drake wants nothing to do with this until a bodacious young nurse catches his eye.
A six-year-old argument between Drake and Josh is suddenly rekindled when their conflicting accounts of a incident at a San Diego Padres game finds them each placing the blame on the other.
Drake's new girlfriend might be tougher than him.  Josh trying to impress Mindy's parents might be even tougher.  Will the boys prevail, or will girl power rule the day?
When Drake and Josh find out Megan have adopted a pet sheep, they want nothing to do with it.
Josh gets a student teaching job in Miranda's classroom, and Drake potentially discovers his new drummer.
Drake gets in trouble at school and is assigned to mentor a young boy.  But when Drake's new "little sibling" likes Josh more than Drake, we discover that brotherly love hurts.
True gets a big assignment at work on the same day she goes back to school. True finds it difficult to juggle school and work.
True works up the nerve to ask out her new crush at school, unaware that he has a huge secret that prevents him from getting close to her.
While True and her rap star boyfriend get closer before he must leave for his upcoming tour, a surprise secret admirer vies for her attention.
Kenan and Kel's lives are disrupted when Kenan's father gets a new job and the Rockmores are forced to move to Pummis, Montana.
Kenan and Kel's lives are disrupted when Kenan's father gets a new job and the Rockmores are forced to move to Pummis, Montana.

There's a big comic book convention in town and Kenan and Kel are dying to go.  Too bad Kenan has to train Rigby's new employee, Sharla, that day.  The guys decide to go anyway and things go downhill from there.
Kenan and Kel manage to score dates with two lovely young ladies, but they end up with their heads stuck in a fence.

It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.

BTR is too famous to be living at the Palm Woods, so Gustavo moves them to Bel Air. However the rules that come with upscale living don’t agree with the guys and they plot their grand escape back to the Palm Woods.

Its date night at the Palm Woods. James helps Carlos on his date with one of the Jennifers, Kendall joins Lucy’s dinner with her parents, and Logan takes a blind date out so he can spy on Camille's date with Jett.

Griffin is pitching a line of BTR merchandise to the CEO of Selmart, but the boys hate the products. Taking matters into their own hands the guys crash the meeting and accidently get their music banned from Selmart stores.

The ladies explore the cliffs of Hawaii and are forced to strike a modelesque pose while jumping into the water. Later the girls learn to pose while deep in the Pacific Ocean.

programmes.st: Be My Friend, Tyra! / Make Over Madness
programmes.d: Thirty-three semi-finalists compete for a chance to be Tyra's friend but only 13 will make it into the Top Model loft in New York City. The lucky finalists are shocked when special guest Perez Hilton reveals their first challenge is to undergo makeovers!
The girls pose for their first official Top Model photoshoot but quickly learn they are only allowed to wear one article of clothing.

The girls receive a surprise visit from cycle 3 contestant Toccara Jones, who puts their fashion knowledge to the test. This week's photoshoot is dance-inspired and forces the girls to pose while demonstrating their fancy footwork.

The girls learn they will be portraying vampires in a tub of blood in this week's photoshoot challenge. Meanwhile, back at their NYC loft, screaming and yelling escalates to an all-time high between two of the girls.
This week the girls pose with comedian Ross Mathews (The Tonight Show and Chelsea Lately) before heading to NYC's garment district to be completely transformed in faux fashion wardrobe.
This week's photo challenge finds the girls striking a pose while on board a New York City Subway car. While at panel, judge André Leon Talley offers a blunt critique of one model's outfit.

Guest judge Whitney Port drops by the loft to surprise the girls before they put their personalities to the test during a runway challenge. This week's photoshoot finds the girls posing with big hair.

The final six girls arrive in New Zealand where they learn they will participate in go-sees with six designers. This week's photoshoot finds them all modeling the same dress with a special guest, a sheep!

Special guest judge and Lord of the Rings actress Sarah McLeod welcome the girls to the Hobbiton in New Zealand, where the girls do a quick five-frame photo shoot. During this week's photoshoot, Tyra goes behind the camera with the final five models.

With the Andromeda damaged by their deadliest enemies, Dylan and Rommie must rescue Tyr, Harper, and Rev from a Magog World ship.
Dylan, Beka, Rev, and Tyr crash land after escaping a gang of Nietzscheans, but soon face a new threat: Rev's need to feed.
The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.
Andromeda answers a distress call when a cargo ship is attacked. Meanwhile, Trance is interrogated after paying a visit to the people.

programmes.st: Last Call at the Broken Hammer
programmes.d: The crew looks for a long-lost Commonwealth leader who has gone into hiding. They find her, but one question remains: is it actually her?

The crew is separated: Dylan, Beka, and Trance go with Rommie to find out about a new weapon being developed on a planet that is distrustful of AI; Harper, Tyr, and Rev struggle for survival when the Maru crashes into the ocean.
Andromeda is tasked with escorting medical ships safely through Drago-Kazov space.
A planet of Commonwealth survivors, led by Dylan's former fiance, is invited to join the new Commonwealth, but when they vote not to join, the Magog are suspected of playing dirty.
An agent of the Abyss tries to lure Harper into joining the Magog.
When they rescue a young prince from an uprising that kills the rest of his family, Dylan and Tyr are asked to be his advisers.
Dylan and his new Commonwealth fleet take on the Drago-Kazov fleet but find it much larger than he expected.
The Magog eggs in Harper are starting to hatch, so the team builds a Tesseract Machine. After unintended time shifts, Trance is replaced by her future self.
Dylan takes over a tourist barge in an attempt to escape mercenaries.
A body identification goes awry when it turns out Beka's former crewmate isn't dead at all.
Andromeda rescues dying people from a drift, but they soon turn into zombies being controlled by a hive-mind.
The Engine of Creation is capable of rewriting the universe according to the owner's wishes. Dylan, Beka, and Trance must obtain it before someone with dark plans gets it.
A black hole knocks out Dylan and sends him into an alternative reality with a wife and child.

Plodding amid the dusky shadows of a peaceful piazza is Polpo’s macabre Stand, which assails any who dare witness the reigniting of the lighter. Giorno deciphers its method of attack, but is soon staring death in the face as Koichi comes to his aid.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Find Polpo's Fortune!
programmes.d: While word of the high-ranking capo Polpo’s alleged suicide sparks astonishment and speculation in the crime syndicate Passione, Giorno is inducted into Bucciarati’s eclectic mafia family. The only problem now is the vast fortune seemingly up for grabs.

Sailing to the Isle of Capri to recover Polpo’s estate, Bucciarati and team are ambushed by a stealthy enemy Stand that deflates them into rubber-like human pelts. Abbacchio, however, thinks he can find his comrades and reluctantly activates his Stand.

Having beheaded their captor by zipper, the team learns its plan has been leaked to Zucchero’s cohort, who is lying in wait on Capri. With fish and gun, Giorno and Mista swim to the island to beat the boat and weed out their assassin-in-waiting.

As Mista closes in on Sale, all signs seem to point to an easy kill. If only it weren’t for the truck hurtling up a mountainous Capri road stuck to his hand or Sale’s power to freeze all objects, gunman Mista would be celebrating over his enemy’s corpse.

programmes.st: The First Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: Within arm’s reach of Polpo’s fortune, Bucciarati and team meet the unassuming Pericolo, a capo who has come to accept the treasure. In presenting the loot, Bucciarati is bestowed not only the rank of capo but also an immense duty: protect Trish Una.

After an encounter with the Hitman Team’s Formaggio, Narancia is left wondering why the world is quickly transforming around him. Narancia hunts down his assailant with a hail of bullets as Formaggio tries to understand his attacker’s tracking skills.

Narancia is unshakable as he uses firepower and CO2 detection to survive Formaggio’s body-shrinking attack. Even beneath a spider’s fangs inside Formaggio’s bottle, Narancia reveals not Trish’s whereabouts but the bullet holes his Stand has left behind.

programmes.st: The Second Mission From the Boss
programmes.d: Giorno, Abbacchio and Fugo travel to Pompeii to find a hidden key pivotal in their protection of Trish. Facing the trio, however, is more than the lonely remains of ancient Roman villas and colonnades. Fugo spots an odd figure in an even stranger mirror.

Illuso has pulled Fugo into his mirror world as Abbacchio rushes to retrieve the key, despite Giorno’s stern advice. But Abbacchio cannot escape a similar fate, leaving him and later Giorno to resort to self-mutilation in favor of death by laceration.

programmes.st: Special Episode Golden Wind The Beginning
programmes.d: Delve into the deadly battles that mold Giorno into an indispensable member of the Passione gang as he and his allies fight to protect Trish and themselves against outlandish acts of violence by members of the Hitman team.

Ready to escort Trish by train, the gang finds on the platform a lone turtle lingering by the drinking fountain, just as the boss instructed. But Bucciarati is stumped—departure is imminent, the enemy is closing in, and the cryptic key appears useless.

Bucciarati and gang hide inside a turtle aboard their train hurtling toward Florence as Mista fights to keep Pesci's body-piercing fish hook from ensnaring his brain. Prosciutto, meanwhile, has released his Stand, rapidly aging everyone on board.

To save his squad, Bucciarati risks all by grabbing hold of Prosciutto and hurling himself off the speeding train, only to be saved by Pesci’s hook. Now, as Pesci savagely fishes for his victim’s heart, Bucciarati’s resolve reaches stunning heights.

Bucciarati and crew head to Venice by car, after a near-death encounter with Pesci. Unbeknownst to them, Melone from the Hitman Team has created an atomizing ancillary Stand from Bruno’s blood and the body of an unsuspecting female train passenger.

Giorno fights transmutation with transmutation as he weaponizes his own severed hand and imbues inanimate objects with life against Melone’s baby Stand. Giorno and team now must learn that the road ahead to Santa Lucia train station is paved with ice.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth.
As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S-Class heroes.
The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama!
Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past and becomes haunted by even more powerful visions.
Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname, but he repeatedly evades her question.
Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment. Why does Kaname go to such great lengths to protect Yuki?
Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.
Light tries to discover where Mello and his Mafia associates are hiding and uses Misa's eyes to find the Death Note's current owner.
Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.
Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.
Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world.
Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi.
Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.

Aoi’s careless action results in her being captured by the 1st Division.
Ibara is critically injured after getting caught in a blast caused by the 1st Division’s tank.

programmes.st: Anita Manning and James Lewis, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the last day for Anita Manning to snatch the lead from James Lewis as they start in Woburn in Bedfordshire and end up at a gripping auction in Cirencester, Gloucestershire.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 1
programmes.d: It's the first day for Charlie Ross and James Braxton to take to the road, and what a day it is! Their adventures start in the Highlands of Scotland in a small town called Cromarty and end in Buckie at a record-breaking auction showdown.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 2
programmes.d: After the excitement of yesterday's auction James Braxton has a long way to go to catch Charlie Ross. Beginning in the fishing village of Cullen in the Highlands of Scotland, they end up in Aberdeen for the auction showdown.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 3
programmes.d: Charlie Ross and James Braxton battle it out for antiques as they wind through Scotland, starting in Tarland en route to auction in Hamilton.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 4
programmes.d: Charlie Ross and James Braxton cruise for antiques in their classic 1954 Alpine Sunbeam which takes them through the scenic town of Blairgowrie to Glasgow for the auction showdown.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and James Braxton, Day 5
programmes.d: It's been an incredible week for Charlie Ross who is well in front of James Braxton as they fight to become the king of buying and selling antiques. They start their final day in Kilbarchan and end at an auction showdown in Ayre, Scotland.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell, Day 1
programmes.d: The tenth season of Antiques Road Trip begins with Philip Serrell taking on Christina Trevanion. Leg one commences in Castle Douglas in Dumfries and Galloway and heads towards the first auction in Newcastle Upon Tyne.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell, Day 2
programmes.d: Day two sees auctioneers Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell begin the next leg of their journey. Starting in Keswick in the heart of the North Lakes in Cumbria, they weave their way towards an auction in Crooklands, in the South Lakes.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell, Day 3
programmes.d: Halfway through their trip, Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell are neck and neck, having each won an auction. They begin day three in the seaside town of Southport, shop their way around Lancashire and land in Lincoln for the auction.

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell, Day 4
programmes.d: Auctioneers Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell embark on their penultimate leg. Christina had great success at the last auction. Can Philip catch her up as they kick off in Manchester and head to the auction in Melbourne, near York?

programmes.st: Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the final leg on Christina Trevanion and Philip Serrell's road trip. Phil won the last auction, but Christina is still in the lead. Who will win as they travel from Liverpool to their final showdown in Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire?

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin, Day 1
programmes.d: It's the start of a brand-new road trip with old hand Charlie Ross and a new star addition to the roster: Glasgow girl Natasha Raskin. Beginning with the glories of the coastal southwest, they end up at auction in Ottery St Mary in Devon.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin, Day 2
programmes.d: On today's trip Charlie Ross and the new girl, Natasha Raskin, are making for an auction in the Hampshire village of Swanmore but starting out in the famous naval city of Portsmouth.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin, Day 3
programmes.d: Halfway through the trip, Natasha Raskin and Charlie Ross begin the day in Berkhamsted, heading for an auction in the Dorset town of Christchurch.

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin, Day 4
programmes.d: Today finds Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin in Farnham in Surrey, on their way to an auction in Towcester, Northamptonshire. Charlie is still in the lead, but can the rookie catch him up before they head into their final leg?

programmes.st: Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the end of the road for Charlie Ross and Natasha Raskin as they set off from Ashby De La Zouche in Leicestershire. With only a few pounds separating them, who will win at the climactic auction in Stansted Mountfitchet, Essex?

programmes.st: Paul Laidlaw and Anita Manning, Day 1
programmes.d: It's a new week and a new pairing as Paul Laidlaw and Anita Manning hit the road on the hunt for antique treasures. They begin their epic adventure in Ford, aiming for their first auction in Leyburn, North Yorkshire.

When an advertising executive selects Mark to star in a commercial for athletic shoes, Mark misunderstands the part he is to play.

programmes.d: It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

programmes.d: Dee Dee's overzealous attempts to help Mona bounce back from her recent broken engagement unintentionally drive Mona into Spencer's passionate arms. Alicia  Calaway guest stars as a trainer.

programmes.d: When Mona finds out the pony Charles gave Dee Dee when they were kids is still around (who she named 'Daddy's Favorite'), Mona's childhood feelings of sibling rivalry resurface.

Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

OTEV is back! Who will capture the veto at the Stage Roach Festival, and will it be used to save the besties on the block? Plus Muffin Gate rocked the whole world, and tonight the saga continues.
Either Daniel or Kyle will be the final non-juror sent packing. Plus, with the Festie Bestie twist ending, who will overcome the legendary BB wall competition?
Who will conquer conspiracy fast and emerge with power? Will the Leftovers continue to dominate, or will someone new turn the house upside down? Plus a new showmance begins to blossom.
Philip is in a new relationship; Linda has just found out which raises her suspicions.
Linda finds out she is pregnant with Phillip being the father.
Upon a visit to the Love Train Diner, Sarah exposes her relationship with Philip.
In the midst of experiencing pregnancy hormones, Linda decides to tell Phillip about the baby.
With Madea's help, Hattie confronts Phillip; the subject is Linda's pregnancy.
Madea and Hattie find out about Linda's pregnancy; things don't bode well for Phillip.

programmes.st: When She Was A Little Girl
programmes.d: In an effort to make Philip feel guilty, Hattie shows him a letter Linda wrote when she was younger.
In a sudden change of heart, Philip has decided he wants to marry Linda; he tells Danny and Hattie.
Linda can't handle the morning sickness any longer.
Philip panics when the engagement ring is missing; Floyd, Sam and Danny try to help him find it.
Philip doubts himself; Hattie convinces him to start over and give Linda the ring.
Hattie throws a surprise party for Linda to make her feel more appreciated by everyone.
Nick hopes to hire a golden-voiced man for voice-over work; Suzanne misplaces Gigi's expensive cashmere sweater.
Nick helps out a coworker by ghostwriting him love letters for a woman on a dating website who turns out to be Gigi.
Nick's identity is usurped by another man named Nick Kingston-Persons.
When Nick lands on a porn website due to a spelling error, a co-worker takes it the wrong way, forcing KAWT employees to undergo sensitivity training.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
Marilyn dates a younger man, but Nick has suspicions about her new beau's true motives. Meanwhile, Kevin breaks his arm.
Friends and extended family gather for a Thanksgiving dinner, but Suzanne forgets the turkey.
Nick is voted as Seattle's sexiest sportscaster, but his newfound celebrity has downsides.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his \\"proposa-versary\\" with Suzanne, who is none too pleased.
Nick attempts to make a profit off an expensive set of African masks that Kevin bought at a yard sale, but instead, he becomes the victim of a larger scam.
Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.

Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Here, Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

Philip doubts himself; Hattie convinces him to start over and give Linda the ring.
Hattie throws a surprise party for Linda to make her feel more appreciated by everyone.
Linda's son Danny tries to plan his mom a surprise baby shower, but Philip has other plans to surprise Linda and asks her to marry him by singing and playing the piano.
Linda ask Ella Payne to help plan her wedding. Meanwhile, Curtis wants Floyd to pay him back for his investment in the diner.
Drew reveals her love for Danny.
Don tries to keep Ashley from moving their kids to Texas, Van puts together a fashion show, and someone from Terrence's past threatens his engagement to Danielle.

While the 9MAG crew is at a loss, Lily makes moves to bring the shop back from the dead. Charmaine blind-sides Danielle with details of Terrence's hookup. Van is shook about his baby girl's new boyfriend. Ryan takes a stance with a new shop.
As the new 9MAG and Loyal Ink each move closer to launch, Ryan tries recruiting an old friend, while Lily and Charmaine clash over rehiring  Danielle.
Ashley returns from Texas after Don gets a DUI, Terrence proposes to Danielle again, and Charmaine goes behind everyone's backs to put herself in charge of Loyal Ink.
Charmaine has a mutiny on her hands after she announces new rules for the shop, Van and Jenn have an explosive fight, and Ryan has a special Mother's Day surprise for Rachel.
Loyal Ink holds an official grand opening, Don and Ashley reassess their marriage after Ashdon goes to the hospital, and Charmaine nabs a Nipsey Hussle radio interview.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Peace Out, America!
programmes.d: The crew throws a going-away party for Mama Bae, Alex moves into Donna's place, Ceaser receives devastating news, and Sky hosts the grand opening of her shop in Miami.
Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2
programmes.d: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.
Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.
Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

The crew continues their stay in Memphis to pay their respects to Kitty's mom. London decides to throw a house party to promote the brand down south. Walt prepares to take his relationship with Jessica to the next step.

Ceaser has a new opportunity to expand Black Ink but not everyone is happy with the deal, leaving him to question where loyalties lie. Donna plans a girls' night that's full of rowdy surprises. Walt and Jess can't see eye to eye.

When a religious young woman is murdered, Danny questions her family who is shocked to learn that she had a secret relationship.
When two Wall Street brokers are killed in drug deals, Danny looks to question a wounded accomplice at the hospital but he is stopped by Linda, who won't let Danny see him until after surgery.

When Danny finds a disoriented man in a park covered in his girlfriend's blood, he finds it hard to believe that the man has no recollection of the night's events until they find a strong narcotic in his bloodstream.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny is emotional since he promised to help her when her parents were taken from her.
As the Reagans rally together to take down the leader of the gang responsible for the murder of someone close to them, Danny looks to the gang leader's girlfriend to lead them to him.
When an armed robbery ends with the death of a police officer, Frank makes it a mission for the NYPD to bring the suspect to justice.
When a famous movie star, Russell Berke, who shadowed Danny for research on his next role, is stabbed, Danny goes to his aid but must keep the crime on the down-low due to Russell’s celebrity status.

Danny becomes the lead hostage negotiator when a prime informant in a large drug case holds Erin at gunpoint inside the courtroom. Also, when Jamie disobeys his lieutenant’s orders and gets suspended, Frank must decide on a proper punishment.
Danny and Baez investigate the death of a teenage girl who appears to have been pushed in front of a subway car by a homeless man.

When Danny and Baez suspect a little girl might be the victim of a kidnapping, the girl’s mother denies it, but her story doesn’t add up. Meanwhile, Frank pays a visit to a priest, a counselor to the NYPD, who was arrested on a DUI charge.

When a gangbanger dies after Jamie chases him away from the boy he is mentoring, Jamie’s conduct is called into question. Meanwhile, Baez goes undercover to get information on Danny’s ex-girlfriend’s fiancée who is dealing drugs from his gym.
When an officer is accused of using excessive force on a suspect, Frank finds his department under scrutiny from the community and the mayor.

Following Frank’s dinner with mob lawyer Angelo Gallo, Gallo is shot, and Frank narrowly escapes with his own life. Meanwhile, Danny is called for jury duty and winds up being the sole dissenting opinion in a murder trial.
Danny and Baez investigate a homicide in which Baez’s estranged brother, a former drug addict, is the lead suspect.
Danny and Baez investigate a local bombing but meet with tension and resistance from the community during the investigation.
Danny’s loyalty is tested when he is assigned to the case of a childhood friend, Mickey, who is under investigation for having ties to an infamous mob family.

When Danny learns from Nicky that there’s a deadly new brand of heroin hitting the streets, he begins an all-out manhunt for the distributor. Meanwhile, Frank pulls out all the stops to assist in getting the drugs off the street.
No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.
A stranger, Bob Jolly, arrives in Virginia City to accuse a drunken Judge Harry Whitaker of sending his innocent father, Carl, to the gallows.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.
Hoss helps Charlie and Will (Charlotte and Willomina), two young girls who just lost their father.  They go on a journey to find their only nearby relative, Aunt Cloe.

On their way to prevent a young woman from encountering the renegade Indians, Joe and Tuck are captured, and in order to save them all, Joe must fight Sharp Tongue, who is the leader of the band who went to school with Joe as a youth.
So the Cartwrights will not be killed, one of Ben's oldest friends must make sure Joe does not win a horse race.

Little Joe convinces Ben to hire Harry Starr, a half-Indian who is accused by other ranchers of being a chronic horse thief. Joe sets out to prove the others wrong, but is the youngest Cartwright's trust misplaced?
Ben invites opera singer Angela Bergstrom to perform at Virginia City's anniversary celebration.  She accepts, but does not tell him that her famous singing voice is long gone
Will is having second thoughts about staying on at the Ponderosa, and outlaws hit the ranch and take him with them.
Hoss is suffering from spring fever, goes to the wrong town and is accused of bank robbery.
In this series' highlight, little Michael Thorpe heads to the high country to ask God to spare his critically wounded father, believing he has found Him in the form of longtime fugitive Tom Cain.
Professor Klump and Amanda pull Hoss into their flying machine scheme. The ""Hoss-mobile""doesn't seem to be destined for a great take-off.
Adam tries to find the good in Howard Mead, a talented troubadour who refuses to stay on the right side of the law.
Little Joe's 19-year old girlfriend is killed by a good samaritan, an explosives expert who had stopped to render aid to the woman's uncle after he suffers a stroke.
A Mormon with two wives is badgered by the town's people and then things get much worse.
As the persecuted party awaits Ben and Hoss' return, Herber is shot and killed. Joe retaliates and shoots Herber's assassin.

For a change, it is Adam rather than Joe who becomes mixed up in one of Hoss' funny exploits. Together they purchase a thoroughbred horse, and end up competing against their little brother in the big Virginia City race.
With Boruto watching intently, Naruto and Sasuke begin their battle against a powered-up Momoshiki!
Boruto has made his rounds apologizing to everyone for his transgressions during the exam, but Momoshiki's prophecy continues to bother him.
Popular actors Tomaru and Ashina receive death threats from an unknown person, so Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Team 7 to guard them.
Tomaru's flirting has Cho-Cho on Cloud 9, but Sarada and the others worry that the lovestruck Cho-Cho has lost her focus on the mission!
The ninja in the gas mask appears again during filming and kidnaps Tomaru.
Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates.

programmes.st: The Hardest Rock in the World
programmes.d: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki.
The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears.

programmes.st: The Other Side of the Moon
programmes.d: The village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.
Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10.
Boruto and his friends are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!
The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the \"Reverse Scale\" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent.

programmes.st: A Fierce Enemy: Garaga's Ferocious Attack!
programmes.d: Boruto and the others work together to obtain the Reverse Scale from Garaga. But the battle proves difficult, as Garaga has the power to sense the location of its enemies and turn them into stone.
Mitsuki heads toward Kokuyou and Sekiei's homeland, the Land of Earth.
Boruto and his friends manage to overcome Kokuyou, and finally catch with up Mitsuki.
Instead of returning home with Boruto, Mitsuki stays with Kokuyou.
Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf.
The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.
Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated.
Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds
In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success.
Ohnoki takes Boruto to a special location to explain his vision of the future, formed after losing his grandchild, Kozuchi.
Kakou uses a rare and powerful Particle Style and pushes Boruto to the edge.
Boruto and Sarada are caught and taken back to the Hidden Stone headquarters along with Ohnoki.
Kirara appears and turns Boruto and Sarada into "dolls" that must obey her, ordering the two to kill each other.
Shocked and confused by the actions of Mitsuki, Sekiei recklessly attacks him.
Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto.
Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki
Boruto and his sister Himawari await Family Day with anticipation.

Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983. The investigation is thwarted and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.

Police solve an old murder case with a painstaking examination of the tool mark on the plastic flex cuff that bound the victim's hands, and a 15-year-old murder case is finally cracked open.
Law enforcement officials fear they may have to release a serial killer from prison until a 24-year-old murder case gives them a chance to lock him up for good.

Testimony about the growth of larvae in dead bodies helps convict the man who stabbed a couple to death and strangled their 4-year-old daughter in 1993.

Police reopen a rape-murder case 25 years after the crime and find enough DNA evidence to bring him to justice. And a confession made to a "Baywatch" TV star helps police solve the three-year-old riddle of a wealthy Newport Beach woman's murder.

Victoria testifies. A guilty verdict is announced and she is sentenced to be hanged as a witch.
Barnabas learns of Victoria’s predicament and vows to avenge the unjust decision against her.

After Barnabas kills Maude, Trask is shocked to find her dead body lying in his bed.
Nathan discovers Maude’s body and promises to help Trask dispose of it in return for Trask’s help.
Barnabas lures Trask to the basement of the Old House and seals him up behind a brick wall.
Carrying Barnabas’ cane, Noah Gifford disguises himself and feigns an attack against Millicent.
Nathan pretends to rescue Millicent, who believes it was Barnabas who attacked her.
At Nathan’s urging, Joshua goes to the Old House and witnesses Barnabas rising from his coffin.
Barnabas tells Joshua he is the Collinsport Strangler. Joshua shoots his son through the heart.
Joshua realizes the truth about Barnabas and insists he is hidden in the tower room at Collinwood.
Nathan decides to drive Millicent mad, but then he notices that she sees lights in the tower room.
Nathan sends Millicent to the tower room where she finds Barnabas. He sinks his fangs into her neck.
Bathia Mapes, summoned from the supernatural, attempts to lift the curse from Barnabas.
In the Old House, Bathia’s spell is interrupted by a visit from Naomi. Bathia is consumed by flames.
Threatening the jailer, Peter leads Victoria from her cell, but she is wounded as she escapes.
Ben leads Victoria and Peter to safety and Victoria dreams that Nathan is about to kill Daniel.
On Nathan’s orders, Noah kidnaps Daniel but he escapes. Victoria hides him in the mausoleum.
As Noah tries to kill Daniel, Victoria shoots him. Nathan finds Peter standing over Noah.

Michele is a single mum living in Derby with her 16 year old daughter Jessica and son Harry. She is on a crusade to liberate women using pole dancing classes. Donna and Garry Mitchell believe that old fashioned values have made their marriage a success.
Jan Melia, anti-traditional routine and convention, swaps places with Debs Collard, who believes in financial success and strict timetables.

Tori is an ex stripper who now runs an adult dancing bar in Brighton with her partner Steve. Paula's number one priority in life is her nine year old daughter Jennifer. Paula takes responsibility for every aspect of her life, including her education.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: Pauly and Vinny's bromance hits a rough patch when they both fall for the same woman, and drama erupts in the house when Nikki's jealousy rubs the other ladies the wrong way.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: The ladies confront their relationship baggage, test out their maternal instincts during a day with Pauly's 'daughter' and pack for a trip on a private jet with the guys.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: After Pauly takes the ladies to Houston to get a taste of his DJ lifestyle, Vinny takes them to Staten Island to get grilled by his Jersey Shore roommate Nicole.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: Pauly and Vinny see a different side of the women when the singles' friends and family members visit the house, and Ronnie and Jenni drop by and bring a surprise with them.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: The truth comes out when Jersey Shore's Jenni and Ronnie subject the singles to a lie detector test, and Pauly and Vinny go on their final one-on-one dates.

programmes.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D & Vinny
programmes.d: Before the final Cab Ceremony, Pauly and Vinny's moms drop by to meet the remaining ladies, and the guys decide who they want to ask for a shot at love.

programmes.st: Fifteen Beds and a Bucket of Puke
programmes.d: Flavor Flav welcomes 20 women to his macadocious mansion with the hope of finding the next great love of his life.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: Rub a Dub Flav

programmes.st: A Friend of Flav's is a Friend of Mine
programmes.d: Ten girls are left and the competition is getting stiff. Flav divides the girls into groups of five and presents them with two challenges.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: The Flavor of Chicken
programmes.d: Flavor Flav has a special surprise for his eight remaining ladies. His moms, Anna Drayton has come to visit.

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: What Happens in Flavor Stays in Flavor
programmes.st: What Happens in Flavor Stays in Flavor
programmes.d: Flavor Flav is a good luck person. So he needs a good luck woman. To test the girls on this trait, he flies the seven remaining women to Vegas on his private jet.
There's six girls left so Flav brings out the big guns. He flies Brigitte Neilsen into town to get to know the girls a little better.
Flav takes two of the young ladies to Palm Springs for a spa retreat where things get muddy, wet and crazy.

Amidst the corridors of Community General Hospital, the hit t.v. show The New Healers is shooting their next episode.
Refusing to believe that a long-time patient, Alex Forman, committed suicide, Dr. Sloan launches his own investigation.

What could be more dangerous than a psychopathic killer with a taste for revenge! Eddie Gault, recently paroled, has only one thing on his mind--making Lt. Steve Sloan suffer for putting him in prison.
Searching for a new way to promote Community General, Norman Briggs decides to have the hospital sponsor a women's professional volleyball team.
It's not just another day at the beach when an investigative reporter out for her daily swim drowns. The lifeguard, Rip, is blamed for the death despite his protests of innocence.
A night school class in law draws Lieutenant Steve Sloan into another police investigation.
It's not child's play when Amanda Bentley's long-time friend Angela Pearson shows up on her doorstep ready to give birth to quadruplets and then disappears after the children are born.

When Amanda wins a contest to appear on her favorite daytime TV drama The Young and The Restless, just about everyone at Community General Hospital tries to wrangle an invitation to join her on the set.

programmes.st: My Baby Is Out Of This World
programmes.d: Dr. Sloan thought he'd heard it all--until psychiatrist Max Frey consulted him about a patient who claimed she'd been impregnated by an outer space alien.
Ashley York murders her wealthy father and cleverly manipulates it to appear as though he killed himself. Dr. Sloan picks away at holes in the story, which leads him directly to Ashley.
Dr. Sloan takes in an abandoned young girl found at the scene of a murder, while Steve and Jesse go about tracking down the killer.
The murder of a beautiful woman around a marine encampment raises suspicions. Dr. Sloan discovers more to her than meets the eye.
Dr. Sloan suspects a cunning D.A. in the murder of an acquitted defendant.
A man wrongfully convicted of murder takes Dr. Sloan hostage. Dr. Sloan hears his story and works to prove the man's innocence. Jesse works feverishly to rescue Mark.
Dr. Sloan shields George Karn from both Steve and Lt. Delaney while investigating his wife's murder.
Steve heads up the investigation when a serial cop killer is on the prowl, while inadvertently dating the killer.
An exhausted Jesse, coming off a 48-hour stint in the hospital, witnesses a man die in the parking garage. Jesse returns with help only to find the man alive.
The High Priest reveals that the Master has only a portion of the crystal that resides in the temple vaults.
Kronos attacks the Doctor.
The Doctor is transported to an eternity of nothingness, as the Master arrives in Atlantis.
The Master summons Kronos, but the creature is uncontrollable and causes an earthquake.
In search of the Doctor, an antimatter creature attacks UNIT and the Doctor is forced to send an SOS.
Following the advice of the First Doctor, the Third Doctor and Jo have crossed through the black hole.
The Doctors are trapped in the universe of antimatter.
Omega intends to escape his antimatter world and needs the Doctors to take his place.
The TARDIS lands on a 1926 ship.
The Doctor faces Drashigs.
The Doctor escapes a trap.
The Doctor races to save Jo.
The Doctor and Jo land on a spaceship in the far future.
Neither the humans nor the Draconians are willing to believe the Doctor.
Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help.
Accused of being spies, the Doctor is sentenced to imprisonment.
The Doctor and Jo are the Master's prisoners.
On Draconia, the Doctor reveals the Master's plan to provoke war.
